name: Sci-fi interface panels
description: Futuristic computer interfaces in many forms: flat panels of rounded colour blocks and line schematics, holographic glass displays floating in a dark room, green wireframe terminals, round targeting and radar displays, and clean white medical scan screens; tidy, technical and calm.
light: screen glow on black, flat colour
cool cyan hologram glow in a dark room, faint reflections on glass
green phosphor glow on an old curved monitor
a soft glow on the brightest elements, the rest in shadow
composition: a full-screen panel: blocks and buttons framing a central schematic
a curved holographic display seen over the shoulder of a seated operator, face not visible
one round radial display filling the frame, rings, ticks and a sweeping line
a wireframe model of a craft or building rotating on a grid
a dense dashboard of many small readouts
camera_or_medium: flat vector interface or a screen render; for holograms, a dark room with translucent light panels
texture_detail: thin line work, schematic outline drawings, grids of small bars and dots, rings and tick marks, scan lines on terminals, translucent layered glass for holograms; labels shown as short blocks or unreadable glyphs, not words
avoid: the curved corner-bracket frames of a known TV series
orange and lilac block frames on every image
subjects: a holographic map of a planet floating over a console
a radial targeting display filling the frame
a green wireframe terminal showing a docking sequence
a white medical scan screen of a robot body
